1.214 × 1015 9.535 × 102 3.225 × 1019 8.562 × 106 1.333 × 107 6 2.565 × 105 5.435 × 1018 6.145 × 1010 2.563 × 1015 1.558 × 103 NA 3.736 × 107 2.521 × 106 result of incorporating spatial influence into the membership calculation dur- ing the fuzzy clustering process. However, notable differences arise between the clustering results when comparing algorithms. The classic FGWC, FPA and HHO (Figures 3a,3c, and4a) tend to generate predominantly large yellow clusters that cover most of Indonesia, accompanied by smaller red and green clusters. In contrast, ABC and TLBO (Figures 3b and 4d) result in clearly delineated red clusters that appear consistently across adjacent areas in Sumatera, Kalimantan, and eastern Indonesia. Similar spatially coherent patterns also appear in the results of IFA and PSO (Figures 4b and 4c), where the clusters clearly group neighboring areas predominantly in red or green.
